label: Cause and indispensable condition in Phaedo 99a–101c
term: cause and indispensable condition in Phaedo 99a–101c
resolution: The bodily prerequisites of the action example, explanation through the choice of what is best, the safe answer for being F, and a cause of coming-to-be have different explanatory roles. Socrates grants the first while withholding its sufficiency for the second; the second-voyage discussion then proposes Forms for the third. No equivalence between these roles is inferred. In particular the example does not establish that every physical explanation is inadequate, that a Phaedo Form is an efficient producer, or that it is the separate maker of the Timaeus.
